'''April 2001 Minneapolis tournament (3 April)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 3 April 2001. It is known from Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2014">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-04-mirkwood-deadbody-style-4-3-01d2014/ mirkwood-deadbody-style-4-3-01], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 4 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-04-mirkwood-deadbody-style-4-3-01d2014/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Joshua Grace]]<ref name="tr-d2020" />
